purpose: Compact terminal public evidence without exporting hot runtime exhaust or private payloads.
authority_boundary: This is a projection/export contract. It does not own task truth, worker authority, CURRENT, promotion, liveness or retention deletion authority.

string_policy.identifiers: ASCII token only: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / @ + # - ; max 240 chars.
string_policy.refs: Repository/durable refs only; ASCII token only; no whitespace, query strings, equals signs, percent escapes or URL credentials; max 512 chars.

closure_rule: Archive terminal closures and compact evidence refs, never heartbeat/poll/progress exhaust.
value_class_rule: REJECT forbidden private/sensitive value classes even when the containing top-level field is allowlisted; fail closed on representative email, phone, URL credential and secret-token values.
